ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central fields with low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and internal markings; approximate visual ratio of 75% white to 25% black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. A thick, irregular black band follows the perimeter. Distinct vertical black streaks and patches are concentrated in the mid-sections of both lobes, particularly near the median notch. A singular small black ring is located in the upper-outer quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 70-80 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; contains numerous jagged peaks and localized valleys with a pixel-amplitude variation of approximately 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges leading to sharp, upward-sweeping distal tips; the leading edge (bottom boundary) exhibits a smooth convex sweep toward the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacle scars or active colonization) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A distinct small black concentric ring is present on the central-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are observed; a significant cluster of vertical and diagonal dark lines is visible on the inner regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (likely tooth rakes) distributed across the white ventral surface; white scarring clusters at the outer fluke tips consistent with prior or current barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular 'bullseye' mark (black ring with a white center) located on the upper-left lobe at approximately 15% of the total width from the left tip.
